strings.house.use_base_1: Use this first presentation as the visual base for Casa 1. The page is ready for final metrics, finishes, pricing, and availability as soon as those details are approved.
strings.house.use_base_2: Use this first presentation as the visual base for Casa 2. The page is ready for final metrics, finishes, pricing, and availability as soon as those details are approved.
strings.house.use_base_3: Use this first presentation as the visual base for Casa 3. The page is ready for final metrics, finishes, pricing, and availability as soon as those details are approved.
strings.house.casa1_lead: A contemporary two-level residence framed by vineyards, open social spaces, and a full family program for countryside living near Santiago.
strings.house.casa2_lead: A modern two-level home with a strong horizontal profile, poolside outdoor living, generous open-plan interiors, and vineyard views.
strings.house.casa3_lead: A single-level barn-style residence with warm wood, dark metal cladding, broad glazing, and a terrace designed for the olive grove landscape.
strings.house.casa1_presentation: Casa 1 is presented as a warm, contemporary home with a strong indoor-outdoor relationship. The plan separates private rooms from the main living sequence and keeps the garage and service areas clearly connected to daily circulation.
strings.house.casa2_presentation: Casa 2 is presented as a compact, polished family home with a broad social level, an integrated garage, and a pool terrace that extends the living areas into the landscape.
strings.house.casa3_presentation: Casa 3 is presented as a refined rural home with a clear rectangular footprint, open social areas, private bedroom zones, and exterior living that opens directly to the garden and surrounding agricultural views.
strings.house.open_social_core_desc: Living, dining, and kitchen areas sit at the center, designed for gatherings and long views toward the landscape.
strings.house.family_program_desc: Five bedrooms across two levels provide privacy, flexibility, and room for guests.
strings.house.two_car_garage_desc: A dedicated garage volume supports everyday use while keeping the front composition clean.
strings.house.andes_setting_desc: The exterior concept positions the house within greenery, mountain light, and an agricultural Chilean context.
strings.house.connected_living_desc: The living room, dining area, and kitchen form a single bright sequence facing the outdoor areas.
strings.house.pool_terrace_desc: A covered terrace and pool zone support relaxed entertaining in the vineyard setting.
strings.house.three_bedrooms_desc_2: The plan balances a main suite on the first level with two private bedrooms upstairs.
strings.house.integrated_garage_desc: A two-car garage anchors the service side of the house and keeps daily access direct.
strings.house.open_social_wing_desc: Living, dining, and kitchen spaces sit together beside the main terrace for an easy indoor-outdoor rhythm.
strings.house.wood_terrace_desc: A broad deck, lounge seating, and hot tub create a relaxed outdoor extension of the home.
strings.house.three_bedrooms_desc_3: The single-level plan organizes private rooms along the central circulation for efficient daily living.
strings.house.olive_setting_desc: The exterior concept frames the home with cultivated greenery, mountain light, and a clean rural arrival.
strings.house.generic_use_desc: Designed as a presentation base while final area, finishes, and commercial specifications are confirmed.
strings.house.casa1_level1_desc: Main suite zones, secondary bedrooms, living room, dining room, kitchen island, laundry/service spaces, and garage.
strings.house.casa1_level2_desc: Additional bedroom suite and flexible private area connected by the central stair.
strings.house.casa2_level1_desc: Main bedroom suite, living room, dining area, kitchen island, service spaces, stair core, garage, and direct outdoor connection.
strings.house.casa2_level2_desc: Two bedrooms, shared lounge, bathroom, storage, and central stair landing.
strings.house.casa3_plan_desc: A linear one-level layout with living room, dining area, kitchen, service spaces, bedrooms, bathrooms, and terrace access along the main facade.
strings.house.casa3_outdoor_desc: Deck, garden circulation, driveway, detached garage volume, and outdoor spa area are presented as part of the arrival experience.
strings.office.hero_lead: Modern office and operational support concept combining workspace, administrative coordination, and practical storage areas in one polished commercial hub.
strings.office.daily_ops_desc: The concept supports business management, logistics, and organizational flow while keeping a refined commercial presence. It is intentionally direct: a workplace that can support growth without visual clutter.
strings.retail.community_desc: The plaza is positioned as a practical, highly visible commercial asset with efficient storefronts and customer-friendly movement. It supports restaurant and retail tenants while keeping the architecture restrained and modern.
strings.cl.catalog.casa1_desc: Two-level residence with generous social areas, five bedrooms, garage, and a contemporary vineyard setting.
strings.cl.catalog.casa2_desc: Modern two-level home with open-plan living, three bedrooms, pool terrace, and integrated garage.
strings.cl.catalog.casa3_desc: Single-level barn-style residence with three bedrooms, warm wood terrace, outdoor spa, and olive grove setting.

strings.us.about.hero_title: International real estate, built with discipline.
strings.us.about.hero_lead: Based in South Florida, we are an international real estate firm focused on the vibrant markets of Broward County and Miami-Dade County. Our work is inspired by the region’s diversity, potential, and dynamic growth.
strings.us.about.who_p1: We specialize in real estate development, investment, land acquisition, and property management, with experience in single-family homes, multifamily residences, offices, retail, and mixed-use projects.
strings.us.about.who_p2: Our integrated approach allows us to oversee each stage of development — from concept to completion — with care, innovation, and precision.
strings.us.about.who_p3: We collaborate with investors, partners, and communities who share our vision of creating long-term value and transforming neighborhoods through thoughtful and sustainable development.
strings.us.about.work1_desc: We align scope, timelines, and constraints early—then execute without surprises.
strings.us.about.work2_desc: Clean architecture, practical details, and efficient operations across the asset lifecycle.
strings.us.about.work3_desc: From concept to completion—we stay hands-on to protect quality and schedule.
strings.us.about.dev_desc: Concept-to-delivery execution with scope control and quality oversight.
strings.us.about.investment_desc: Pragmatic underwriting, durable fundamentals, and clear exit optionality.
strings.us.about.land_desc: Site screening and corridor strategy across Broward and Miami-Dade.
strings.us.about.property_desc: Stewardship that supports leasing performance and long-term asset health.
strings.us.about.asset_desc: Single-family, multifamily, offices, retail, and mixed-use projects.
strings.us.about.partnerships_desc: Aligned capital + transparent execution with investors and communities.
strings.us.about.value_desc: Our goal is to build spaces where people can live, work, and thrive—contributing to the continued evolution of South Florida’s urban landscape.

strings.industrial.cl_p1: Our commercial projects division is expanding quickly in response to demand for modern, high-function industrial space. We focus on assembling strategic corridors, sharpening project concepts early, then steering construction and stabilization so warehousing assets stay efficient to operate, adaptable to tenancy changes, and competitive for long-term leases.
strings.industrial.cl_p2: The broader industrial spectrum remains robust: SMB operators continue adding storage and outbound capacity to satisfy e-commerce workflows. Demand shows staying power—which underwrites resilient capital deployment when timing, sites, and product mix align thoughtfully.
strings.industrial.cl_p3: With partnerships on the ground, disciplined underwriting, and a growing pipeline, we prioritize investments that marry immediate leasing velocity with durable exit optionality anchored to digital commerce fundamentals. A disciplined sector. Repeatable playbook. Attractive entry point into next-wave industrial product.
strings.model.modena.video_desc: The Modena presentation focuses on scale, light, and circulation through a clean unbranded walkthrough. Use the player for full playback control; the Home and portfolio cards reuse this clip on hover for quick preview.
